items.name: JsonWriter
items.summary: Writes messages to a delta lake table.

methods.name: arrow_schema
methods.summary: Returns the arrow schema this writer encodes under (fixed at construction).

methods.name: buffer_len
methods.summary: Approximate encoded (parquet) size written since the last flush, including files already finalized by a size roll. Monotonic within a flush window, so usable as a threshold for calling [`flush`](Self::flush).

methods.name: buffered_record_batch_count
methods.summary: Returns the number of record batches streamed since the last flush.

methods.name: flush
methods.signature: async fn flush(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<Add>, DeltaTableError>
methods.summary: Finalize all files written since the last flush and return their [`Add`] actions, resetting internal state to handle another flush window.

methods.name: for_table
methods.summary: Creates a JsonWriter to write to the given table, using the table's schema.

methods.name: reset
methods.summary: Resets internal state, discarding any data written since the last flush.

methods.name: try_new
methods.signature: async fn try_new(table_url: Url, schema_ref: ArrowSchemaRef, partition_columns: Option<Vec<String>>, storage_options: Option<HashMap<String, String>>) -> Result<Self, DeltaTableError>

methods.name: with_target_file_size
methods.summary: Sets a target file size; once an in-progress file reaches it the writer finalizes it and rolls a new one. Without this the writer emits a single file per partition per flush (the default).

methods.name: write
methods.signature: async fn write(&mut self, values: Vec<Value>) -> Result<(), DeltaTableError>
methods.summary: Write a chunk of values into the internal write buffers with the default write mode

methods.name: write_with_mode
methods.signature: async fn write_with_mode(&mut self, values: Vec<Value>, mode: WriteMode) -> Result<(), DeltaTableError>
methods.summary: Decode the JSON values into a record batch and stream it into the dataset writer; partitioning and parquet encoding happen incrementally, and files are finalized at flush.
